description: RK1828 (RKNN3) LLM worker runtime — staged build artifact, mirroring deploy/rk-runtime/. Rebuild per services/rk1828-llm/BUILD.md.
built_on_device: recomputer-rk3588-devkit, inside a Debian 12 container (gcc 12.2, cmake 3.25) = the image's userland
note: Layout is load-bearing: the binary's rpath is $ORIGIN/lib, so librknn3_api.so must stay in lib/ next to it. CRITICAL: librknn3_api.so is only a 55 KB dispatch shim that dlopen()s librknn3_api_rkcp.so (search order: ./, ./lib/, /usr/local/lib, /usr/lib, /usr/lib64). Because that is a dlopen and not a link-time dependency, `ldd` on the binary looks perfectly clean when the backend is absent, and the failure surfaces only as `rknn_init fail ret=-1` at model load. The whole lib/ directory must be staged, not just librknn3_api.so. Build inside Debian 12, not on a newer host OS: a binary built on the devkit's Ubuntu (gcc 15) needs GLIBC_2.38 / GLIBCXX_3.4.32 and does not start in the debian:12 image; this build needs at most GLIBC_2.34.
